source.exact_context:
> [!NOTE]
> If you enter a value for Remaining work that is higher than Work, you will see an error message telling you that this is not possible. You will have to enter a value lower than Work to be able to save the new value.
> Additionally, the value for Remaining work cannot be removed if a value for Work exists. If you wish to unset Remaining work, you need to also unset Work.

revision.revised_target: Given Work=8h and stored Remaining work=7h, enter Remaining work=9h and attempt to save through the work-package UI. After the UI settles and the page is refreshed, stored Remaining work is still 7h. The Work value and successful page reload are controls; prevention of saving the invalid Remaining-work value is the single scored obligation. The target makes no assertion about the presence, absence, or wording of error feedback.

reviewers.concise_reason: The source directly prohibits saving Remaining work above Work. Retaining the stored 7h after attempting 9h and refreshing is one independently deletable, browser-observable obligation in a bounded deterministic fixture. Work and successful reload are explicitly unscored controls; error feedback is excluded.
